summary.intent: Fix the memory loop TUI injection tab test to cover all active memories and replace meaningless raw scores with clear INJECT/SKIP labels. Then remove skill, insights, improve, and permissions commands, keeping only summary and memory-loop.
summary.outcome: Injection tab now uses PreviewSelection to show all memories with INJECT/SKIP labels and skip reasons instead of raw scores; two new render tests added. Four command files and four package directories deleted; shared helpers relocated to session_cache.go; all tests and lint pass.

repo: PreviewSelection() returns a SelectionReport with both Matches and Skipped (with reasons), while SelectRelevant() only returns matched memories — use PreviewSelection for full visibility.
The insights/ package is a library used by summary and memory-loop, not just a command; it must be kept even when removing the insights command.
backfillSummaries and backfillFacets wrapper functions were unused after the command removal — only the ForRows variants are called from memory_loop_cmd.go.
summarytui/root.go had nolint comments that gofmt strips; those changes should be reverted to avoid unrelated diffs.
The explanatory_insights.go file is a hook handler, not a command, and must be retained.

code.finding: View updated to show INJECT/SKIP labels with skip reasons (e.g. 'not active', 'scope mismatch', 'low strength') instead of raw score numbers.
testPromptResultMsg now carries a full SelectionReport instead of just a slice of matches.
Switched from SelectRelevant() to PreviewSelection() to get the full matches+skipped report.

New file consolidating shared helpers relocated from deleted command files: refreshCacheIfStale, metadataToSessionRow, extractToolCounts, backfillSummariesForRows, backfillFacetsForRows, sessionRowsToSummaries, renderUsageLine.
Pre-existing staticcheck lint: redundant nil check before len; fixed while in the area.

workflow: When deleting commands that share helpers with surviving code, extract helpers to a new file before deleting — avoids cascading compile errors.
After running mise run fmt, check for unrelated nolint-stripping changes (especially in capabilities.go / TUI root files) and revert them before committing.
Unused wrapper functions should be deleted immediately when the only callers are removed; lint (unused write / deadcode) will catch them.

friction: Initial test assertion for empty state failed because 'RECENT INJECTIONS' section contained 'Injection Detail' which includes 'INJECT' as a substring — required a more specific assertion.
render_test.go had unusedwrite lint warnings for activeTab assignments since tests called injectionTab.view() directly; those assignments had to be removed.
session_cache.go initially imported the deleted insights package, causing compile failure — had to restore insights/ as a library package.
sessionRowsToSummaries and renderUsageLine were missing from session_cache.go after initial extraction, requiring a second pass to locate them in the deleted improve_cmd.go via git show.
backfillSummaries and backfillFacets wrapper functions were extracted but turned out to be unused, triggering lint; had to be deleted.
ifElseChain lint warnings in debug hint blocks in session_cache.go required additional edits.
gofmt stripped nolint comments from summarytui/root.go as an unrelated side effect of mise run fmt, requiring a revert.
open_items: The insights/, insightsdb/, improve/, and skillimprove/ library packages were retained as dependencies of summary/memory-loop — worth revisiting whether all are still needed or can be trimmed.
